description: Query the decision knowledge graph. Filter by type, subproject, code symbol, file path, tag, or time — answers "why was this architecture chosen?" with the actual decision record. Defaults to approved decisions; use include_pending or review_status for other tiers. Read-only. Returns JSON: { decisions: [{ id, title, type, content, tags, review_status, cluster_ids? }], clusters_summary?, total_results }. Supports `output_format: "toon"`.

as_of.description: Only decisions active at this ISO timestamp

git_branch.description: Branch filter: "current" (default), "all", or a branch name

include_pending.description: Also return pending review-queue decisions (default: approved only)

index_only.description: Omit full `content` (default false) — pick ids cheaply, then pull content with `get_decision`

order_by.description: Result ordering: "recency" (default), "created_at", or "heat" (popular + fresh; falls back to recency when disabled)

output_format.description: Output format: "json" (default), "markdown" (tool-specific), or "toon" (30-60% fewer tokens on tabular data).

review_status.description: Restrict to one review tier ("pending" = review queue; overrides default)

search.description: Full-text search query (FTS5 with porter stemming)

verification.description: Filter by verification verdict (implies verify=true): "stale" or "ok"

verify.description: Verify linked code is still fresh (default true); stale rows are flagged `stale: true`. false skips the check.

name: query_decisions
